title: Beautiful towels that lack absorbency; wooden spoon is the only useful item
text:
Beautiful towels that lack absorbency; wooden spoon is the only useful item. The two towels are gorgeous in my opinion. The one towel is a rich red plaid and the other is white with a beautiful red pompom fringe and ‘TIS THE SEASON TO BE JOYFUL written on the front. They are decorative for the holidays. However, they are not absorbent so I cannot use them for anything but a decoration. The water just runs off them similar to the way water beads and runs off a windshield that has Rain-X on it. I couldn't dry my dishes or my hands with these towels.

They can be washed in cold water and should be ironed after they are hung dry—unless one doesn’t mind the wrinkles. They should not be dry cleaned, bleached, or tumble dried.

After washing them and hanging them dry, they still were not absorbent. Both towels also shrunk about two inches.

In summary, I rated this set 3 stars because the towels only work as a decoration for me. The only useful item is the spoon. If the towels were absorbent, I would have rated this set 5 stars. It does, however, get 5 stars as a decorative linen.

PS I put a link to the textile “washing” symbols in the comments section of this review since the care instructions on the towels are in symbols only.
